name: Homestake
summary: Raymond Davis Jr. and collaborators used a deep-underground chlorine detector to make the first sustained measurement of solar neutrinos. The observed deficit became the solar-neutrino problem and motivated the later demonstration of neutrino flavour transformation.
detection_principle: Electron-neutrino capture transforms chlorine-37 into argon-37 in a large perchloroethylene tank. Rare argon atoms are extracted and their radioactive decays counted. The technique integrates the flux over long exposures rather than reconstructing individual neutrino energies.
